Claire — thanks, glad the demo landed. Draft MAP and short eval plan attached (Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf). High level plan and our recommended signoff cadence below.

Summary (short):
- MAP milestones: technical POC (2 weeks), security evidence exchange (3 business days after POC), exec decision window (we recommend 5/10), procurement and SOW routing (target sign by 5/18).
- Approval gates: engineering/POC owner, security (SOC2 + data flows), legal (T&Cs), procurement (purchase order / billing).
- DocuSign plan: we will issue the SOW via DocuSign on 5/15 with a 7-day signing window; we can compress to 3 days if Acme confirms single-signature authority.
- Proposed start date: 2028-06-01 (flexible +/- 3 business days).

Key asks for Acme: please confirm who the single signer will be (name + email) so we can pre-populate DocuSign, and confirm if you require any additional evidence (e.g., customer-specific encryption notes).

Operational day-0 checklist (short):
- Day -7: final model/region pin in the MAP and required quantization profile agreed.
- Day -3: onboarding runbook shared with CS + your infra (we'll include runbook link in DocuSign packet).
- Day 0: account activation, routing tests (3 smoke queries), confirm webhook delivery, 1:1 onboarding call.

I've put Rishi on copy for pricing approval and Grace for onboarding ops. If you want a compressed signature window we'll support.
